operations.name: admin_get_analytics_affluence
operations.description: Customer affluence over the full bookings history (affluence_stats_v1). Read-only aggregations: bucketed evolution with previous-period delta and the seasonal month/year comparison.

operations.name: admin_get_analytics_overview
operations.description: Analytics V1 uses an idempotent selected-range rebuild; it has no outbox.

operations.name: admin_get_bot_ai_restaurantid
operations.description: Bot AI routing, provider keys, RAG knowledge and DSPy pipeline graph (wa_bot_ai_providers_v1 / wa_bot_dspy_pipeline_v1).

operations.name: admin_get_bot_settings_restaurantid
operations.description: WhatsApp bot settings per explicit restaurant id + prompt preview (root IA tab).

operations.name: admin_get_branding
operations.description: Branding belongs to the Configuracion page (`/app/config`), which the backoffice navigation maps to the `reservas` section. Gating these endpoints under `ajustes` returned 403 for app-version 0.4 users (who are whitelisted for `reservas` but not for `ajustes`) and broke the logo upload from `/app/config?content=contacto`.

operations.name: admin_get_comida_categorias
operations.description: Unified category catalogue (per food type + global). Declared before the /comida/{tipo} wildcard so the static "categorias" segment wins.

operations.name: admin_get_config_chatgpt_plugin_tokens
operations.description: ChatGPT plugin credentials — root only. Always scoped to the caller and their active restaurant, so a token can never outlive or exceed the session that created it.

operations.name: admin_get_config_hour_split
operations.description: By-hour client split configuration (toggle + per-hour percentages).

operations.name: admin_get_config_location_booking
operations.description: Location booking toggles (floor/salon reservation, default + per-date override).

operations.name: admin_get_config_minimax
operations.description: MiniMax AI config (api key + model) — root only.

operations.name: admin_get_config_mobility_day
operations.description: Mobility question ("problemas de movilidad") per-day override over the global default.

operations.name: admin_get_config_special_dates
operations.description: Special dates (reservas especiales) — per-date settings CRUD.

operations.name: admin_get_config_stripe_connect
operations.description: "Cobros online" (connected account); no keys per tenant.

operations.name: admin_get_legal_pages
operations.description: Legal pages CMS (aviso-legal, booking-policies, proteccion-datos). The editor lives on /app/config (Configuracion page), which the backoffice navigation maps to the `reservas` section (sectionForPath in lib/navigation.ts). Gating these endpoints under `ajustes` returned 403 for app-version 0.4 users (whitelisted for `reservas` but not for `ajustes`, e.g. the owner admin after migration 131), breaking the tab with {"message":"Forbidden"}. Same alignment as #240 did for /branding: the API follows the page's RBAC section.

operations.name: admin_post_members_whatsapp_subscribe
operations.description: The bot connection panel lives on the Contact/Config page, so it must be reachable through the members section it belongs to. Gating it behind `ajustes` hid it for app version 0.4 (that version whitelists miembros but denies ajustes): the status GET returned 403, entitled stayed null and the panel rendered nothing.

operations.name: admin_get_platform_dashboard
operations.description: Platform (superadmin) endpoints — cross-tenant management. All gated by requireBOSuperadmin (is_superadmin=1 only).

operations.name: admin_get_platos
operations.description: Legacy aliases consumed by current backoffice comida screen.

operations.name: admin_get_pos_bootstrap
operations.description: POS. Paid checkout is authoritative boundary for stock deductions and covers.

operations.name: admin_get_pos_fiscal_series
operations.description: Fiscal groundwork: numbering series, simplified invoice, its duplicate copy and the rectifying invoice for a refund. Issuing is behind the refund permission because both actions create a fiscal record.

operations.name: admin_get_pos_pin
operations.description: Staff PIN: set your own, verify someone else's to approve an action. Under the sell gate because they are part of working the till rather than administration.

operations.name: admin_get_pos_tickets_id_courses
operations.description: Coursing: which courses a ticket has, and firing one to the kitchen.

operations.name: admin_post_pos_tickets_id_guest_label
operations.description: Naming a separated check is a sell-side action (it happens while the table is still ordering), not an accounting edit.

operations.name: admin_get_restaurant_pages_visibility
operations.description: Page visibility belongs to the Carta/Comida pages it configures, so it is gated by the menus section. Gating it under "ajustes" returned 403 for app-version 0.4 users (who are whitelisted for comida/menus) and made the food-type settings switch fail.

operations.name: admin_get_stock_warehouses
operations.description: Stock control. Section gate is admin-only by default; role table can grant it later.

operations.name: admin_get_tables_template_floornumber
operations.description: Layout template (cross-day). Owns limit_area_template_points and draw_elements_template for the given floor.

operations.name: admin_patch_users_id_version
operations.description: A/B app version management: root only, per user + active restaurant.
